customNodeParameters.name: WHITELIST_AD_BLOCKER
customNodeParameters.description: Whitelists Ad blocker restrictions. If you have monetized your feed, be sure to add the account(s) to one of these lists so that their sponsored posts are not removed from your feed(s).
customNodeParameters.displayName: Whitelist: Exempt Users From Ad Blocker?

customNodeParameters.name: BLOCK_ADS
customNodeParameters.description: Block posts which contain advertisement specific language. "BUY NOW!" "CLAIM YOURS TODAY"

customNodeParameters.name: BLOCK_HASHTAG_ADS
customNodeParameters.description: Block posts with advertisement hashtags. #ad

customNodeParameters.name: WHITELIST_AFFILIATE
customNodeParameters.description: Whitelists all affiliate restrictions. Users on these lists will not be removed if they post links with affiliate links or URL shorteners with brand/website name.
customNodeParameters.displayName: Whitelist: Exempt Users From Affiliate Link Restrictions?

customNodeParameters.name: BLOCK_UNIVERSAL_AFFILIATE_LINKS
customNodeParameters.description: These domains are used for affiliate links. Examples include: urlgeni.us, geni.us. These domains are removed regardless of any other context.

customNodeParameters.name: BLOCK_AMAZON_AFFILIATE_LINKS
customNodeParameters.description: Searches many different amazon domains, amazon.com, amzn.com, a.co, a.to, amazon.co.jp, amazon.nl, and searches for affiliate tags in the URL. Posts that contain affiliate tags in these URL's will be removed.

customNodeParameters.name: BLOCK_AMAZON_WITH_TINY_URLS
customNodeParameters.description: Searches for mentions of Amazon and the use of a URL shortener, bit.ly, tiny.url, etc. and removes these  posts. This option is HIGHLY recommended as the vast majority of these shortened URL's are affiliate spam, though the possibility of a false positive does exist (which is why this is a separate toggle). This does not block all URL shortener links, only those that include the text Amazon.
